collection.title: Mercedes-Benz C Class Saloon 1993 to 2000 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz C Class Saloon 1996 to 2000 (C202) model requires a 24" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
